simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to עֲדֶן (H5728) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: adv.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: עֲדֶן (ʻăden) means till now First listed occurrence: Eccl 4 2.

definitions.full: H5728. aden or adenah עֲדֶ֫נָֿה Eccl 4:2 Baer Ginsb (al. עֲדֶ֫נָּה ), abbreviated עֲדֶן 4:3 ( from עַלהֵֿן עַדהֵֿנָּה, ; compare Late Hebrew עֲדַיִן e. g. Ned. Eccl 9:10 ), adverb hitherto, still.
